defect_1_unevaluable_predicted_cvi.behaviour: gates on CLUSTOPT_CVIS = {calinski_harabasz, davies_bouldin, silhouette, dbcv} and ML2DAC_ONLY_CVIS = {dunn_index, coggins_jain_index, cop}, and returns float("nan") for every other class. 54 of the 61 classifier classes fall through to that NaN branch.
defect_1_unevaluable_predicted_cvi.consequence: _oriented maps NaN to -inf, so every candidate ties at -inf; the strict "oriented > best" comparison never fires and the incumbent stays the FIRST valid candidate, which is the top-ranked warmstart of the nearest neighbour. The predicted CVI has no influence on selection at all.
defect_1_unevaluable_predicted_cvi.computability: not a limitation of the metrics: ViewMetricEngine._clustopt_raw builds a GenericCVIEvaluator for an arbitrary metric list, so all 58 ClustOpt classes were computable. The gate set was simply never widened when the M1/M2/M3 variants were added.

defect_2_default_direction.behaviour: returns value if CVI_DIRECTION.get(cvi) == 'maximize' else -value; CVI_DIRECTION holds only the 7 original CVIs, so any of the other 54 classes is silently treated as MINIMIZE
defect_2_default_direction.status: latent in Stage 3A because defect 1 made every value NaN first; it would fire the moment defect 1 is fixed

defect_3_sign_inverted_ml2dac_cvis.source: external/ml2dac/src/ClusterValidityIndices/CVIHandler.py::CVI.score_cvi negates MAXIMIZE-objective scores; unified_mkr/ml2dac_cvi_adapter.compute_ml2dac_only passes the negated value through; ML2DAC/indomain/mkr.py CVI_DIRECTION then marks dunn_index and coggins_jain_index as maximize
defect_3_sign_inverted_ml2dac_cvis.consequence: maximising a negated score minimises the true index, so the WORSE partition is preferred

behavioural_demonstration.expected: a well-separated partition should score better

scope_note: These are Stage-3A implementation defects in the ML2DAC selection path. They do not affect the Stage-4 physical layer, which contains no scoring, and they do not affect AutoClust or ClustOpt.
bearing_on_stage3b: the Stage-3B statement that ML2DAC CVI selection collapses coincides exactly with the arms whose predicted CVI was never evaluated (M1 158/324, M2 216/324, M3 230/324, M0 0/324). Whether that collapse is a property of ML2DAC meta-learning or an artefact of defect 1 cannot be settled without a decision on Stage-4 scoring semantics, and no Stage-3 replay is proposed here.
